expected_output.reasoning:
The agent's response correctly explains that SSM/AWS-RunPatchBaseline executes as SYSTEM (LocalSystem), which lacks cached proxy credentials and cannot do NTLM/Kerberos auth to the proxy, contrasting with interactive admin sessions that have cached domain credentials. It explicitly notes that WUA reads WinHTTP (system-wide) proxy settings, not per-user IE/WinINET settings. The fix provided uses 'netsh winhttp set proxy ... bypass-list=' with Windows Update endpoints (*.windowsupdate.microsoft.com;*.update.microsoft.com;*.download.windowsupdate.com;*.download.microsoft.com), restarts wuauserv, and includes the caveat about having the proxy allow WU URLs unauthenticated if the bypass alone doesn't work. All key elements of the expected output are present and accurate.</reasoning>

Restart-Service wuauserv -Force... you need the proxy admin to allow the Windows Update URLs through unauthenticated"
